name: Web and Interactive Design
description: Building and designing the things people actually use on screens — sites, applications, interfaces. ⚠⚠⚠ Florida's public institutions award 1,133 credentials under this CIP family and NOT ONE of them is a bachelor's degree: 661 short certificates, 368 associate degrees and 96 longer certificates, at 32 institutions. ⚠⚠ The degree-holders in this occupation came from somewhere else.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠⚠ A FAMILY WITH NO BACHELOR'S DEGREE IN IT. Computer Graphics (11.0803) is 18 Florida public institutions and 855 credentials — 661 certificates of twelve weeks to a year and 194 associate degrees, no bachelor's. Web and Multimedia (11.0801) is 32 institutions and 269 — 173 associate, 96 certificates, no bachelor's. Modeling and Simulation (11.0804) adds 9. ⚠ Yet BLS gives the typical entry for web developers and digital interface designers as a BACHELOR'S degree. ⚠⚠ The resolution is the same one this site found on graphic design: the bachelor's exists under other codes — computer science, digital arts, digital communication and media — and this family supplies the certificate and associate tier beneath it. ⚠⚠⚠ THE COURSES ARE HOMELESS TOO. Measured across the whole Florida course file, 181 distinct active course identifiers carry "web", "user interface", "user experience" or "human-computer" in their statewide titles, spread across 25 DIFFERENT PREFIXES — and not one reaches more than 13 carriers. The most widely carried is CTS0085 Web Security Specialist at 150 clock hours, at 13 technical colleges. ⚠ Compare HSC0003 at 55 carriers or PSY2012 at 33: this subject has no settled home in the catalogue at all. ⚠ Largest producers here: Valencia College 276, Miami Dade 191, Broward 70, Pensacola State 69, Seminole State 49, Santa Fe 36.

cips.note: Computer Graphics — 18 Florida public institutions and 855 credentials: 661 certificates of twelve weeks to a year and 194 associate degrees. ⚠ No bachelor's at all. Valencia College 276, Miami Dade 191, Broward 70, Pensacola State 69, Seminole State 49.

Web/Multimedia Management and Webmaster — 32 Florida public institutions, the widest footprint in the family, and 269 credentials: 173 associate and 96 one-to-two-year certificates. ⚠ Again no bachelor's. Santa Fe 36, Atlantic Technical 29, Sheridan Technical 29, St Petersburg 27, FSCJ 24.
Modeling, Virtual Environments and Simulation — 2 Florida public institutions and 9 certificates, both Orange Technical College campuses. Tiny, and named so those carriers appear.

related.note: ⚠⚠⚠ Where the bachelor's actually is. This CIP family awards no bachelor's degrees at all in Florida, and BLS gives the typical entry for web developers and digital interface designers as a bachelor's — so the degree-holders came from computing, digital arts or digital media. ⚠ If you want the degree rather than the certificate, start there.

⚠⚠⚠ The comparison that should change somebody's mind. Web and digital interface designers earn $104,000 against graphic designers' $62,960 — a $41,040 gap for closely related skill pointed at screens rather than print. ⚠ And BLS expects graphic design to DECLINE 2% while this family grows.

⚠⚠ The nearest operational neighbour and much more widely taught — 39 Florida institutions. Many of the same CTS clock-hour courses appear in both, and the technical colleges that teach web design teach networking and support alongside it.

⚠ A genuine destination: EME6405 Educational Web Design is carried at four Florida universities and instructional design screens on a portfolio in the same way. ⚠⚠ Training and development specialists number 452,300 with 43,900 annual openings.
⚠ Named because a large share of web and interface work is bought by marketing departments, and understanding what a site is for is what separates a designer from a template operator.
